description: Required block provider for TmNotionEditor. Handles all block-level CRUD, reordering, type conversion, duplication, and cross-page moves. Every editable action in the editor flows through this provider.

methods.name: GetBlocksAsync
methods.description: Returns all top-level blocks for the given page, ordered by their Order field.

methods.name: GetChildBlocksAsync
methods.description: Returns child blocks for a parent block (used by toggle, column, and synced-block containers).

methods.name: CreateBlockAsync
methods.description: Creates a single block and returns the persisted version with the server-assigned ID.

parameters.name: block
parameters.description: Block to create (Id may be a temporary client-side GUID).

parameters.name: afterBlockId
parameters.description: Insert after this block ID, or null to append.

methods.name: CreateBlocksAsync
methods.description: Batch-creates multiple blocks (e.g. on paste). Returns them in insertion order.

parameters.name: afterBlockId
parameters.description: Insert after this block ID, or null to append.

methods.name: UpdateBlockAsync
methods.description: Persists content changes for an existing block (text edits, media URL changes, etc.).

methods.name: ReorderBlocksAsync
methods.description: Persists the new block order after a drag-and-drop reorder.

parameters.name: orderedBlockIds
parameters.description: All block IDs in their new order.

methods.name: MoveBlockToPageAsync
methods.description: Moves a block to a different page.

parameters.name: afterBlockId
parameters.description: Insert position in the target page.

methods.name: DuplicateBlockAsync
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a block (including child blocks for containers) and inserts it directly after the source.

methods.name: ConvertBlockTypeAsync
methods.description: Changes a block's type while preserving its text content (e.g. Paragraph -> Heading1). Uses the block's stored content. Returns the updated block.

parameters.name: newType
parameters.description: Target block type from the BlockType enum.

methods.name: ConvertBlockTypeAsync
methods.description: Overload that converts a block using the editor's live contenteditable HTML instead of the stored content, so text typed since the last blur is not lost. This is a default interface member: providers that do not override it ignore currentHtml and fall back to the two-argument overload, so existing implementations keep working unchanged.

parameters.name: newType
parameters.description: Target block type from the BlockType enum.

parameters.name: currentHtml
parameters.description: The block's live editor HTML, or null to use the stored content.

methods.name: GetBlockLinkAsync
methods.description: Returns a shareable URL that deep-links directly to this block.
